translation.label: SVG and flat-color translation
translation.credit: Charles Lacouture, Répertoire chromatique (1890). Chromolithographs by G. Severeyns. Digitized by the Getty Research Institute, via Internet Archive.
translation.provenance: Exact SVG and JSON assets from the prior Lacouture web translation export; adapted into this viewer without importing the original application or hosting configuration.
translation.approximation: Scan-derived screen sRGB approximations, not calibrated measurements of the original inks. Paper, aging and scanning influence the colors. SVG geometry and typography are a reconstruction; paper wear and fine lithographic texture are omitted.
translation.rights: The historical work is recorded NOT_IN_COPYRIGHT by the source catalog. This translation is distinct from Lacouture’s original and the Getty digitization; no additional license is asserted here.
